title: Write the first store tests
objective: Turn behavior into assertions executed by Vitest in a terminal.
tasks: Replace the first two it.todo calls with executable tests using a new CounterStore in each test.
Assert the initial value is 0, then in the second test assert change(4) gives 4 and change(-2) gives 2.
Export your edited project and run pnpm exec vitest run in a real terminal; expect two passing tests and three pending.
hints: Store.change accepts a delta, not the desired final value.
The browser buttons call the real store, but they never execute /Store.test.ts.

title: Test both clamping boundaries
objective: Verify overshoots and repeated attempts at the limits.
tasks: Replace the clamping it.todo with a fresh-store test that changes by +100, +1, -100, then -1.
Assert values 10, 10, 0, and 0 after the respective operations.
Run the actual Vitest suite in a terminal; expect three passing tests and two pending.
hints: Large changes check clamping, while the additional ±1 checks the behavior at an already-reached boundary.
Keep the earlier tests intact so ordinary additions and subtraction remain covered.

title: Test reset and independent stores
objective: Prove reset changes a nonzero value and instances do not share state.
tasks: Replace the reset todo: change a new store by 7, assert 7, reset, then assert 0.
Replace the independence todo: create two stores, change only the first by 3, and assert first.value is 3 while second.value is 0.
Run Vitest in a terminal; expect all five tests passing with no pending cases.
hints: Resetting a store that is already zero would not detect a broken reset.
Construct the two independent stores inside the same test so their values can be compared.
